title: Lakebase now available in three additional regions
body:
Lakebase is now available in the following regions:

* `eu-west-3` (Europe - Paris)
* `ap-southeast-3` (Asia Pacific - Jakarta)
* `ap-northeast-2` (Asia Pacific - Seoul)

For the full list of supported regions, see [Region availability](/aws/en/oltp/projects/manage-projects#availability). To get started, see [Get a Postgres database](/aws/en/oltp/projects/get-started).
